eresourcesSection.label: E-Resources & Free Volumes
eresourcesSection.heading: Instant Access to 70,000+ Free Volumes
eresourcesSection.subheading: Read public-domain classics, open textbooks, and reference materials directly in your browser. Download for offline reading anytime.

featuresSection.label: Everything you need
featuresSection.heading: The complete library experience.
featuresSection.discoverDesc: Find exactly what you need with robust category filters and AI-driven recommendations based on your reading history.
featuresSection.trackingDesc: See exact shelf availability and queue positions.
featuresSection.renewDesc: Extend your borrowing time with a single tap.
featuresSection.finesDesc: No more surprise fees. See exactly what you owe and get automated email reminders before any book is due.
featuresSection.facilitiesDesc: Read digital content natively inside the app, and reserve study spaces or lab computers weeks in advance.
featuresSection.cardDesc: Your library ID lives safely in your phone.
featuresSection.supportDesc: Request new books or report issues directly to admin.

howItWorksSection.heading: How it works
howItWorksSection.subheading: Get started in seconds, not hours.
howItWorksSection.step1Desc: Takes 60 seconds. Your institution's book catalog appears immediately — no setup, no waiting.
howItWorksSection.step2Desc: Physical books reserved with one tap. 70,000+ e-books readable right in the app — PDF or EPUB.
howItWorksSection.step3Desc: Come back daily to read, borrow, or return. Earn stickers, unlock rewards, and hit milestones that actually mean something.

streaksSection.label: Build Habits
streaksSection.heading: Consistency rewarded.
streaksSection.subheading: Track your daily reading, earn exclusive stickers, and build a lasting reading habit.

patronCardSection.label: Digital Patron Card
patronCardSection.heading: Your campus library card, always ready
patronCardSection.subheading: Check out books at the library circulation desk with your personalized digital barcode. No physical cards required.
patronCardSection.scanInstructions: Scan at circulation desk to check out or return physical books

faqSection.label: Got Questions?
faqSection.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faqSection.q1: How do I borrow physical books from my campus library?
faqSection.a1: Browse the catalog, click Reserve on any available volume, and show your digital patron pass at the circulation desk.
faqSection.q2: Are the e-resources completely free to read?
faqSection.a2: Yes! All 70,000+ e-resources in BookBuddy are open-access, public domain, or licensed for campus students at zero cost.
faqSection.a3: Check in daily on your student dashboard or read an e-book for at least 5 minutes to keep your streak alive.
faqSection.q4: What happens if I have an overdue fine?
faqSection.a4: You can view your fine breakdown in the student portal and settle dues online or at the library circulation counter.

ctaSection.heading: Ready to transform your reading experience?
ctaSection.subheading: Join thousands of students and faculty already using BookBuddy to explore books and level up reading habits.

forCollegesSection.label: CAMPUS & INSTITUTIONAL PARTNERSHIPS
forCollegesSection.heading: Ready to onboard your college?
forCollegesSection.subheading: Modern cloud library management, real-time analytics, automated fine workflows, and multi-tenant isolation built for higher education.
forCollegesSection.feature1Desc: Complete data privacy and security scoped to your college branch.
forCollegesSection.feature2Desc: Eliminate manual check-in overhead with instant barcode scanning.
forCollegesSection.feature3Desc: Bulk-import student rosters via CSV or direct SIS sync.
forCollegesSection.feature4Desc: Real-time circulation metrics and utilization snapshots.

footerSection.tagline: The Library in Your Pocket. Manage course reserves, read free e-books, track your streaks, and connect with your campus library.
